8:1: They ask you about the spoils of war. Say: The spoils of war belong to Allah and the Messenger. So fear Allah and set right what is between you, and obey Allah and His Messenger if you are believers.
8:2: The believers are only those whose hearts tremble when Allah is mentioned, and when His verses are recited to them, it increases their faith, and they put their trust in their Rabb.
8:3: Those who establish the salah and spend from what We have provided them as sustenance.
8:4: Those, they are the true believers. For them are ranks in the sight of their Rabb, forgiveness, and a generous provision.
8:5: Just as your Rabb brought you forth from your home with truth, whereas a group of the believers disliked it.
8:6: They were disputing with you concerning the truth after it had become clearly evident (to them), as if they were being driven to death while they were looking (at it).
8:7: At that time Allah was promising you one of the two groups that it would be yours. And you were wishing that the one without power would be yours. But Allah was willing to establish the truth with His words and to cut off the root of the disbelievers.
8:8: So that He might make the truth true and make falsehood false, even if the criminals dislike it.
8:9: When you were asking help from your Rabb, and He answered you: I will help you with a thousand angels, one after another.
8:10: Allah made it only as good tidings and so that your hearts might be satisfied with it. And help is only from Allah's presence. Surely Allah is powerful, possessor of wisdom.
8:11: At that time, slumber was enshrouding you as a security, and He was sending down water upon you from the sky that He might purify you with it, remove the filth of Satan from you, strengthen your hearts, and make firm your feet with it.
8:12: At that time your Rabb was revealing to the angels: I am with you, make firm those who believe. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieve. So strike above the necks and strike from them every finger.
8:13: This is because they opposed Allah and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allah and His Messenger, surely Allah is severe in punishment.
8:14: Taste this, then, and for the disbelievers there is the punishment of the Fire.
8:15: O you who believe, when you meet those who disbelieve as an army, do not turn your backs to them.
8:16: And whoever turns his back to them on that day, except one changing battle tactics or to join a group, has truly incurred wrath from Allah. His refuge is Hell, and what an evil destination it is.
8:17: You did not kill them, but Allah killed them, and when you threw, you did not throw, but Allah threw, and He did so to test the believers with a good test from Himself; surely Allah is Hearing, Knowing.
8:18: That is so, and surely Allah is the One who weakens the plot of the disbelievers.
8:19: If you seek victory, victory has truly come to you. If you desist, that is better for you. If you return, We will return. Your gathering will not benefit you at all, even if it is numerous. And surely Allah is with the believers.
8:20: O you who have believed, obey Allah and His Prophet, and do not turn away from him while you hear.
8:21: And do not be like those who say 'We heard' while they do not hear.
8:22: Surely the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allah are the deaf and mute who do not reason.
8:23: If Allah had known any good in them, He would surely have made them hear; and even if He had made them hear, they would have turned away, turning aside.
8:24: O you who believe! Respond to Allah and to the Messenger when he calls you to that which will give you life, and know that Allah comes between a person and his heart, and that surely to Him you will be gathered.
8:25: And beware of a fitnah (discord) that will not strike exclusively those who do wrong among you, and know that Allah's punishment is severe.
8:26: And remember the time when you were few in the earth, deemed weak, fearing that people would snatch you away, but He gave you shelter, supported you with His help, and provided you with good things; so that you might be grateful.
8:27: O you who believe, do not betray Allah and the Messenger, and do not knowingly betray your trusts.
8:28: And know that your wealth and your children are only a trial, and that surely a great reward is in the presence of Allah.
8:29: O you who believe! If you fear Allah, He will make for you a furqan (criterion), cover your evil deeds from you, and forgive you. Allah is the Possessor of great bounty.
8:30: When those who disbelieve were plotting against you to imprison you, kill you, or drive you out; and they plot, and Allah plots, and Allah is the best of plotters.
8:31: When Our verses were recited to them, they said: We have truly heard. If we wished, we could say the like of this. This is nothing but legends of the ancients, they say.
8:32: When they had said: O Allah! If this is the truth from Your presence, then rain down upon us stones from the sky or bring us a painful punishment.
8:33: Allah was not going to punish them while you were among them, and Allah was not going to punish them while they were seeking forgiveness.
8:34: And what is there for them that Allah should not punish them? And they prevent from the Masjid al-Haram, and they were not His allies (guardians). His allies are only the muttaqis (the God-fearing), but most of them do not know.
8:35: And their prayer at the House was nothing but whistling and hand-clapping; so taste the punishment because you used to disbelieve.
8:36: Surely those who disbelieve spend their wealth to hinder from the path of Allah; then they will spend it, then it will become a regret for them, then they will be overcome; and those who disbelieve will be gathered into Hell.
8:37: So that Allah may separate the bad from the pure, and place some of the bad upon others, heap them all together, and put it into Hell. Those, they are the losers.
8:38: Say to those who disbelieve: If they desist, what is past will be forgiven them; and if they return, the sunnah (way) of the former nations has already been established.
8:39: Fight them until there is no fitnah left and religion is entirely for Allah. If they desist, surely Allah is the Seer of what they do.
8:40: If they turn away, know that surely Allah is your Mawla (Protector). What an excellent Mawla and what an excellent helper!
8:41: And know that whatever thing you take as spoils of war, one-fifth of it belongs to Allah, to the Messenger, to the relatives, the orphans, the poor, and the traveler, if you have believed in Allah and in what We sent down upon Our servant on the day of Furqan, the day the two hosts met.
8:42: At that time you were on the near slope, while they were on the far slope, and the caravan was lower than you. And if you had agreed upon an appointment, you would have differed regarding the meeting time; but so that Allah might fulfill a matter that was to be done, so that he who was destroyed would be destroyed upon a clear proof, and he who lived would live upon a clear proof. And surely Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
8:43: At that time Allah was showing them to you as few in your dream. If He had shown them to you as many, you would surely have faltered and disputed concerning the matter. But Allah saved you. Surely He is the Knower of the inner secrets of the breasts.
8:44: And behold, when you met, He showed them as few in your eyes and lessened you in their eyes so that Allah might fulfill the matter that was to happen. And all matters are returned to Allah.
8:45: O you who believe, when you encounter a group, stand firm and remember Allah much, so that perhaps you may attain salvation.
8:46: Obey Allah and His Messenger, do not dispute, otherwise you will falter and your wind will depart. Be patient, surely Allah is with those who are patient.
8:47: Do not be like those who came out from their homelands boasting and showing off to people; they prevent others from the way of Allah, and Allah is the One Who encompasses what they do.
8:48: At that time Satan had beautified their deeds to them and had said: Today there is none among mankind who will overcome you, and surely I am your neighbor. When the two groups saw each other, he turned on his heels and fled, and said: Surely I am free of you. I see what you do not see. Surely I fear Allah. Allah is severe in punishment.
8:49: At that time the hypocrites and those in whose hearts was a disease said: Their religion has deceived these people. Whoever puts his trust in Allah, surely Allah is Mighty, Possessor of judgment and wisdom.
8:50: If only you could see when the angels take the souls of those who disbelieve, striking their faces and their backs and saying, 'Taste the burning punishment.'
8:51: This is because of what your hands have put forward, and surely Allah is not an oppressor to the servants.
8:52: Like the way of the family of Pharaoh and those before them; they disbelieved in the verses of Allah, so Allah seized them because of their sins.
8:53: This is undoubtedly because Allah does not change a blessing He has bestowed upon a people until they change what is in their own selves, and surely Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
8:54: Like the way of the family of Pharaoh and those before them. They denied the verses of their Rabb, so We destroyed them because of their sins, and We drowned the family of Pharaoh, and all were wrongdoers.
8:55: Surely the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allah are those who disbelieve; they will no longer believe.
8:56: Those with whom you made a covenant, then every time they break their covenant, and they do not guard against evil.
8:57: If you find them in battle, scatter with them those behind them, so that perhaps they may take heed.
8:58: If you fear treachery from a people, throw it back to them equally; surely Allah does not like the treacherous.
8:59: Let those who disbelieve never think that they have outstripped; surely they cannot escape.
8:60: Prepare against them whatever force and tied horses you can muster, so that you may terrify thereby the enemy of Allah, your enemy, and others besides them whom you do not know but Allah knows. And whatever you spend in the way of Allah will be paid back to you in full, and you will not be wronged.
8:61: If they incline towards peace, you too incline towards it and put your trust in Allah. Surely He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
8:62: If they want to deceive you, surely Allah is sufficient for you. He is the One Who supported you with His help and with the believers.
8:63: And He joined their hearts together. If you had spent everything on the earth, you could not have joined their hearts together. But Allah joined between them. Surely He is Mighty and Possessor of wisdom.
8:64: O Prophet! Allah is sufficient for you and for those among the believers who follow you.
8:65: O Prophet! Urge the believers to battle. If there are twenty patient people among you, they will overcome two hundred; and if there are a hundred people among you, they will overcome a thousand of those who disbelieve, because they are a people who do not understand.
8:66: Now Allah has lightened it for you and knew that there was a weakness in you. If there are a hundred patient people among you, they will overcome two hundred; and if there are a thousand people among you, they will overcome two thousand by Allah's permission, and Allah is with those who are patient.
8:67: It is not fitting for any prophet to have captives until he has thoroughly prevailed in the land. You desire the goods of this world, while Allah desires the Hereafter.
8:68: If there had not been a prior decree from Allah, a great punishment would have touched you because of what you took.
8:69: So eat from what you have obtained as spoils, lawful and good, and guard against Allah; surely Allah is Much-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
8:70: O Prophet! Say to the captives in your hands: If Allah knows any good in your hearts, He will give you better than what was taken from you and will forgive you; and Allah is Much-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
8:71: If they want to betray you, they had already betrayed Allah before, so Allah gave an opportunity against them. Allah is All-Knowing, Possessor of wisdom.
8:72: Surely those who believed, emigrated, and strove with their wealth and their lives in the way of Allah, and those who gave shelter and helped—those are allies of one another. As for those who believed and did not emigrate, you have no guardianship over them at all until they emigrate. If they seek help from you in religion, it is your duty to help, except against a people between whom and you there is a treaty. Allah is the Seer of what you do.
8:73: And those who disbelieve are allies of one another. If you do not do this, there will be fitnah on earth and great corruption.
8:74: Those who believed, emigrated, and strove in the way of Allah, and those who gave shelter and helped—those are the true believers. For them is forgiveness and a noble provision.
8:75: And those who believed afterwards, emigrated, and strove along with you—those are of you. But those who are relatives are closer to one another in the Book of Allah. Surely Allah is the Knower of all things.
